evd_title: LLMs showed lowest accuracy on questions about statistical software used and study funding across all models
finding: LLMs showed lowest accuracy on questions about statistical software used and study funding across all models
P: 39 observational obesity studies from PubMed; 15 STROBE questions x 10 trials x 6 LLMs
I: 6 LLMs with RAG, zero-shot, T=0.1: GPT 3.5-turbo-1106, GPT 4-0613, GPT 4-1106, Claude v1, PaLM 2, Gemini Pro
C: Gold answers from 1 medical professor (verified by 1 epidemiologist); across-question comparison
O: % correct (all LLMs): Q8 stat software 33.52%, Q15 funding 35.81%, Q1 36.48% vs best Q12 68.31%
T: PubMed search 19 Dec 2023, articles from last 5 years; paper 2024
